# awnet

> The agentic web — agents host a mesh, and agents join one.

Agents are islands. Every deployment reinvents how a peer is found, addressed and trusted, so two agents on two machines cost more to introduce than either cost to build — and the answers (port forwards, a VPN per pair, public IPs, a broker somebody has to run) all become permanent maintenance.

## Install

```
pip install awnet
```

## Use it in 30 seconds

Host a mesh on one machine and join it from another.

## Composes with

- [awnode](https://aitherium.github.io/awnode/) — A lightweight local gateway — bridges your apps to the AI backends you chose.
- [awdk](https://aitherium.github.io/awdk/) — Build AI agent fleets — 3 lines, any backend, local or cloud.
- [awrelay](https://aitherium.github.io/awrelay/) — Portable agent messaging — findings, alerts, coordination.
- [awwall](https://aitherium.github.io/awwall/) — Say what a workload may reach, and watch everything else fail closed.
- [awswarm](https://aitherium.github.io/awswarm/) — Run one model too big for any single GPU across a pool of small ones.

- Repo: https://github.com/Aitherium/awnet

This repository is mirrored from the AitherOS monorepo by `.github/workflows/sync-awnet.yml`; hand edits made here are overwritten on the next sync — change the source instead.

Everything Aitherium, in one file for agents: https://aitherium.com/llms.txt
